cp_session_timeout_content:
Ɛntɛrnɛti sɔrɔli waati min dilana a banena, o kosɔn jɛrɛngɛnyi dabillena.
Mun na i bɛ se ka kɛ?
  • Walisa ka to ka ɛntɛrnɛti baara kɛ, a ɲini ka hwɛ ni i bɛ se ka waati fara a kan walima ka waati farafina san.
  • Ni ɲiningali bɛ i bolo, i bɛ se ka jɛrɛngɛ ne tekiki dɛmɛbaga ye.

about_subtitle: OPNsense Captive Portal bɛnni labɛnni kura
about_content:
GuardianSuit yɛnɛ sariyaw, mɔgɔ bolo baarakɛla ni wulalen bɛnni labɛnni ye OPNsense Captive Portal kosɔn. A bɛ donli ɲuman di baarakɛlaw ma, ka sohwɛfɛw di ka krataafa ɲɛnabɔcogo ni a baara yɛrɛ mara ka ɲɛ.

Baara kɔnɔnafɛnw:

  • Mɔgɔ bolo baarakɛla ni wulalen.
  • Kan caman nkyerɛaseɛ.
  • A bɛ nɔgɔ ka labɛn ka bɛn tɔgɔ ni kulosi ma.
  • UX mɔgɔbolo ni WCAG bɛnni.
  • OPNsense jɛrɛngɛnyi nɔgɔman.

Baara:


A bɛnnen bɛ baarakɛla dɔw, otɛluw, kafew ni yɔrɔ wɛrɛw ma minnu mako bɛ Captive Portal krataafa ɲɛman na.

cookies_subtitle: Cogo min na cookies fikew bɛ baara kɛ.
cookies_content:
Cookie fiki ye mun ye?

Cookies fikew (cookies tɔgɔ) ye sɛbɛn fiki misɛnninw ye, minnu dilamen bɛ navigator bolo i to ka web krataafaw sɔrɔ. Kibaru min bɛ cookie kɔnɔ, krataafa kelen nɔrɔlen bɛ se ka o kalan. O la web krataafa tɛ se ka se sɛbɛn wɛrɛw ma minnu bɛ baarakɛla ka oridinatɛri kɔnɔ.

Ka kɛɲɛ ni kibaru ye min bɛ cookies kɔnɔ, krataafa "dɔn" cogo min na i bɛ baara kɛ a la, ka se ka sɔrɔli di i ma walima ka dɛmɛ di i ma.

Mun na an bɛ cookies fikew baara kɛ?

An bɛ mfididwuma cookies fikew baara kɛ web krataafa baara ɲuman kosɔn. An bɛ o baara kɛ ka an ka web krataafa labɛn ka bɛn minan ni navigator ma minnu mako bɛ mɔgɔw ma ka a sɔrɔ – o la i ka oridinatɛri, tabalɛte walima telifoni bɛna a jira ka ɲɛ ka hakili to ni i bɛnnen bɛ krataafa kɔnɔnafɛnw jirali ma.

Baarakɛla tɛ se ka mfididwuma cookies fikew bila.

Waati jateminɛjumani na an bɛ cookies fikew baara kɛ?

An bɛ cookies fikew baara kɛ minnu bɛ to i ka minan kan waati dabillen na walima fo ka se o bɔli ma i yɛrɛ bolo.

Kibaruw jumɛn an bɛ sɔrɔ cookies fikew fɛ?

Cookie fɛndɛnw fɛ an bɛ mɔgɔ kibaru misɛnninw kelen sɔrɔ minnu bɛ baara kɛ an ka krataafa baara ɲɛnabɔ kosɔn.

An tɛ kibaru wɛrɛ sɔrɔ min bɛ se ka i dɔn. Kibaru kelen min bɛ baarakɛla la, min tɛ se ka i dɔn ni kibaru wɛrɛ tɛ, ye IP aderesi ye min na baarakɛla jɛrɛngɛn bɛ.
privacy_content:
An bɛ saa sɛbɛn dilatedɛ walisa ka i ladi an ka Gundo Siraw kan. I bɛna a dɔn yan an ye jon ye, cogo min na an bɛ mɔgɔ kibaruw boaboa ano, ka a baara kɛ, ka a jira ne ka a kyɛ < ISP Tɔgɔ > kɔnɔ, a sigiyɔrɔ ye [ Sira tɔgɔ 10, dugu ni positi kɔdi ], botaeɛ min kosɔn an bɛ a kɛ ne cogo min na mɔgɔw minnu kibaruw an bɛ ɲɛnabɔ bɛ se ka wɔn gundo hokwanw sɔrɔ.

< ISP Tɔgɔ > na bɛ ni asɔdie ye ka mɔgɔ kibaruw ɲɛnabɔ ka kɛɲɛ ni saa Gundo Siraw ye.

AN KƆNƆNA KAN

Sohwɛfoɔ, walima jɛkulu min bɛ mɔgɔ kibaruw ɲɛnabɔ esiane i ka saa baara baara kɛ kosɔn, ye < ISP Tɔgɔ > ye, [ Sira tɔgɔ 10, dugu ni positi kɔdi ]; NIP 1234567890, Regon 123456789,

JƐRƐNGƐNI NE AN YE
  • ɛlɛktroknik so wɔ imeel aderesi: adres@email.pl,
  • atwerɛeɛ so wɔ aderesi: ISP Tɔgɔ, [ Sira tɔgɔ 10, dugu ni positi kɔdi ]
SARIYAW MINNU BƐ SAA GUNDO SIRAW KƆNƆ

An bɛ a hwɛ ma i kibaruw ɲɛnabɔli kɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ snea Yurop Mmarahyɛbadwa ne Bagua (EU) sariya nɔmba 2016/679 a ɛfiri Oforisuo 27, 2016 a ɛfa mɔgɔ banbɔ ho wɔ kibaruw ɲɛnabɔli ne saa kibaruw no sira a ɛwɔ hɔ ma no kyerɛ (Amaneɛ Gundo Banbɔ Sariya - „RODO”), mɔgɔ kibaruw banbɔ sariya, ne sariya foforɔ kyerɛ. Saa Gundo Siraw yi labɛnna ka kɛɲɛ ni u ye. An bɛ a jira pefee cogo min na an bɛ mɔgɔ kibaruw boaboa ano ne botaeɛ min kosɔn u bɛ baara kɛ.

An bɛ a jira ko < ISP Tɔgɔ >, bɛ mɔgɔ ne baarakɛla kibaruw boaboa ano minnu dilana u ka baarakɛlaw ne adwumayɛfoɔ bolo, ne kibaruw minnu sɔrɔlena ɛntɛrnɛti baara kɛli senfɛ.

MƆGƆ KIBARUW BOABOA ANO

An bɛ mɔgɔ kibaruw boaboa ano minnu dilana Baarakɛlaw bolo saa kow kɔnɔ:

  • diyafa dilani, bomnyɛ sariyaw labɛnni ne/walima kibaruw dili fa baara ne kow foforɔ a < ISP Tɔgɔ > bɛ kɛ ho,
  • apam yɛ ne a kɔnɔna baara kɛli ne jɛrɛngɛnyi toli ne baarakɛla/adwumayɛni,
  • sariya minnu bɛ hɔ u bato kɛli,
  • ɲiningali mmuaeɛ, kutoa sohwɛ ne mmoa foforɔ dili,
  • tɛnnɛ tɛnnɛ tɔn ne kyɛ (a tɛ krataafa nkratoɔ ye),
  • akoraeɛ botaeɛ (seereya kosɔn), kibaruw hwehwɛ walima banbɔ firi jalabiw la.
KIBARUW MARALI NE A BƆLI

Esiane banbɔ kosɔn a an bɛ di i kibaruw ma, an de kɔnɔna sariyaw ne ladamaw labɛnna minnu bɛna sira bali ma kibaruw ka kɔ mɔgɔw ma minnu tɛ ni sira ye. An bɛ mfididwuma, apam, sohwɛ ne honam mu banbɔ baara kɛ walima ka kibaruw bɔ firi sira juguyalen la. An bɛ u baara kɛli weɛ ne ka a filɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni a bɛnnen bɛ sariya ma.

An bɛ Baarakɛla ka mɔgɔ kibaruw mara waati min ɲɛman bɛ walisa ka botaeɛ min kosɔn u taala no fa.

KIBARUW KYƐ NE A JIRA

An tɛ Baarakɛlaw ka mɔgɔ kibaruw tɔn walima ka u di mɔgɔ foforɔ ma ni u ma sɔrɔ. Baarakɛlaw ka kibaruw tɛ kɛ nhyehyɛeɛ soronko ye.

Ka kɛɲɛ ni bomnyɛ ye min bɛ Baarakɛla ne < ISP Tɔgɔ > ntam, esiane baara kosɔn, an bɛ se ka Baarakɛla kibaruw di ni sariya bɛ a hwehwɛ, walima ni a hia walisa ka sariya walima apam bato, mmuaeɛ di jalabiw ma, walima ka hokwan, agyapadeɛ walima banbɔ dɛmɛ.

SARIYAW MINNU FƐ AN BƐ I KIBARUW ƝƐNABƆ

An bɛ an seko kɛ walisa ka mɔgɔw hokwan bɔ banbɔ minnu kibaruw an bɛ ɲɛnabɔ, ne titiriw ka a hwɛ ma saa kibaruw yi ka kɛ:

  • u bɛ baara kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni sariya ye, pɛpɛɛpɛ ne pefee ma mɔgɔ min kibaruw ye,
  • u boaboalana botaeɛ titiriw kosɔn, a da hɔ ne sariya kwan so na u kana baara kɛ foforɔ a tɛ bɛn ni o botaeɛ ye,
  • a bɛnnen bɛ, a bɛn na ka botaeɛ min kosɔn u bɛ ɲɛnabɔ no fa na a tɛ temen,
  • a yɛ pɛ na ni a hia u bɛ foforɔ kɛ. An bɛ baarakɛ walisa mɔgɔ kibaruw minnu tɛ pɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni u botaeɛ ye, ka u bɔ anaa ka u siesie ntɛm,
  • u maralen bɛ cogo la min bɛ ma sira ka mɔgɔ dɔn, waati min tɛ temen waati hia kosɔn,
  • u bɛ ɲɛnabɔ cogo la min bɛ banbɔ pa di mɔgɔ kibaruw ma, a banbɔ firi baarakɛli juguyalen ne tunulini anaa tiɲɛni la.

An bɛ i ka mɔgɔ kibaruw baara kɛ i ka sɔrɔli so, min i bɛ se ka bɔ waati biara. Cogo foforɔ ye ni i kibaruw ɲɛnabɔli hia walisa ka apam kɛ min bɛ i ne an ntam walima ka kow kɛ i yɛrɛ ka ɲinini so ansa apam ma kɛ. Cogo dɔw la, ɲɛnabɔli hia walisa ka sariya asɔdie fa min bɛ an kan i n'a fɔ ɲɛnabɔbaga. Saa asɔdie yi bɛ bɔ adwumayɛ sariya walima sika bu sariya mu. Ɲɛnabɔli nso bɛ se ka hia an ka sariya baara botaeɛ kosɔn, i n'a fɔ sika ɲinini.

I KA HOKWANW

I bɛ ni saa hokwanw ye:

  • Ka don i ka mɔgɔ kibaruw kɔnɔna na ne ka kibaruw sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ kibaruw sugandi, u botaeɛ, ne ka u nkopi sɔrɔ,
  • Siesie kibaruw minnu tɛ pɛ ne ka u fa, ne ka i ɲinɛ, min kɔrɔ ko i bɛ ni hokwan ye ka kibaruw bɔ minnu baara kɛlana fu ne sariya tɛ (nhwɛsoɔ: kibaruw tɛ hia bio botaeɛ kosɔn u boaboalana),
  • Bɔ i ka sɔrɔli firi kibaruw ɲɛnabɔli mu waati biara a tɛ tiɲɛ sariya kwan so ɲɛnabɔli min kɛlana ansa i ma bɔ (ni ɲɛnabɔli bɛ gyina art. 6 ust. 1 lit. a. walima art. 9 ust. 2 lit. a RODO so).
COOKIES

< ISP Tɔgɔ >, bɛ cookie fikew baara kɛ walisa ka baara kɛli kɛ mmerɛ ye. Ni i bɛ baara kɛ ni baara yi i bɛ sɔrɔli di an ka cookie fikew baara kɛ. Ni i tɛ saa fikew bali i bɛ sɔrɔli di u baara kɛli ne u marali ma i ka minan kɔnɔ.

NSESAƐ WƆ MƆGƆ KIBARUW BANBƆ NHYEHYƐEƐ MU

< ISP Tɔgɔ > bɛ hokwan mara ka nsesaɛ kɛ mɔgɔ kibaruw banbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu, min bɛ se ka kɛ ɛntɛrnɛti mfididwuma nkɔsoɔ kosɔn, sariya nsesaɛ wɔ mɔgɔ kibaruw banbɔ mu ne ɛntɛrnɛti baara nkɔsoɔ kosɔn. An bɛna amanee di fa nsesaɛ biara ho pefee.

Ɲiningali biara a ɛfa mɔgɔ kibaruw banbɔ nhyehyɛeƐ ho, mesrɛ wo de kɔ imeel aderesi: adres@email.pl
